prompt: Painterly cinematic realism with Old-Master light, one warm grade, fine film grain. Wide shot. A lone man seen from behind, his face never visible, on a rock in the rising water, and the vast ark, its whole hull smeared pitch-black under a flat plank roof, far off in the rain. Grey dusk, rain and mist. Final and quiet. The ark is one long, low, box-shaped wooden hull with straight sides of rough planks and flat square ends, the same low height from end to end. The ark has no mast, sail, prow, figurehead, funnel or smokestack, no smoke rising from it and no band along its waterline. The ancient Near East in the days of the flood: the great wooden ark, the open water, the mountains of Ararat and the empty new earth. No stone buildings, towers, churches, glass lanterns, modern clothing or roads. No text, no logos.
